# Operations Performance Standards Review

This document highlights critical areas requiring immediate attention within the Operations department concerning performance standards.

Key areas for investigation and update include:

*   Teller performance standards.
*   Branch efficiency, requiring urgent investigation and quarterly optimization efforts.
*   Cash flow standard updates.
*   Teller performance specifically in relation to Strategy 2026 objectives.
